retrievalProfile.description: A close-up, high-texture portrait of a Black woman with natural hair, featuring overlapping geometric hairline typography in the upper-left quadrant.
triggerTerms: earthy warm lighting on dark skin
excludeWhen: modern high-gloss digital photography is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, intimate portrait of a woman with a large afro, eyes closed in a contemplative or soulful expression, wearing heavy metallic jewelry and snakeskin-textured clothing, overlaid with ultra-thin geometric typography that interacts with the subject's hair.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the organic, soft texture of the afro and the sharp, rigid lines of the typography.
The hand placement on the forehead creating a diagonal line that leads to the face.
The metallic sheen of the jewelry echoing the highlights on the skin and the white of the text.
The snakeskin pattern in the foreground providing a complex textural base for the composition.
coreInvariants: Large, rounded afro-textured hair filling a significant portion of the frame.
Warm, earthy color palette with deep shadows.
Subject's eyes closed or looking downward.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered but angled diagonally, with the head tilted and the afro filling the top and left edges.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the lips and closed eyes, serves as the emotional anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright white text in the top left, follows the arm down to the face, and rests on the textured clothing at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, dense texture of the hair acts as a functional negative space for the white typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks (skin and hair).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted gold and silver (jewelry and snakeskin highlights).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the dark subject and the white text.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' lacks a crossbar or has a very low one.
Letters are often tightly tracked or overlapping.

composition.relationshipToImage: overlaid on dark hair for maximum legibility

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in different scales; the secondary text is smaller but maintains the same geometric DNA.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule separating the main title from the subtitle.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and 70s/90s soul aesthetic.
Provides the necessary sharp vertices and monolinear thinness.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a Black woman with a large, textured afro, eyes closed, wearing a snakeskin jacket and heavy silver jewelry. Use warm, earthy lighting with deep shadows in the hair.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay two lines of uppercase text in the top-left corner using an ultra-thin geometric sans-serif font in white. Add a thin white horizontal line between the two lines of text.

verificationChecks: Is the text weight thin enough to be called 'hairline'?
Does the hair fill at least 40% of the frame?
Is the lighting warm and focused on the skin's texture?

adjustableVariables: Pattern of the clothing (snakeskin vs leather)
mustRedesign: Avoid using the specific artist name or album title.
Do not replicate the exact jewelry patterns.
postGenerationChecks: Typography is perfectly legible against the hair.
The snakeskin texture is sharp and detailed.
The composition maintains a strong diagonal flow.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait(Subject: Black Woman, Hair: Afro, Mood: Soulful) + Texture(Snakeskin, Metallic) + Typography(Geometric Sans, Hairline, White, Top-Left).
